add_maintenance.label: Maintenance compensation
add_maintenance.text: Hello, {amount} papel has been added to your account as compensation for a brief maintenance. Thank you for your understanding.

add_event.label: Event/achievement reward

add_gift.label: Community thank-you gift
add_gift.text: Thank you for supporting our community. We are gifting you {amount} papel.

add_refund.label: Error compensation/refund

add_support.label: Support thank-you
add_support.text: As a goodwill gift after your support request, {amount} papel has been added to your account.

remove_penalty.label: Rule violation/penalty

remove_chargeback.label: Incorrect transaction correction

remove_fee.label: Transaction fee

remove_refund.label: Refund reversal

all_maintenance.label: Maintenance compensation (all members)
all_maintenance.text: As compensation for scheduled maintenance, {amount} papel has been added to all member balances. Thank you.

all_announcement.label: Community incentive (general)
all_announcement.text: For community motivation, {amount} papel has been granted to all members. Enjoy!

all_event.label: Event reward (general)

all_season.label: Season closing bonus
all_season.text: As a season closing bonus, {amount} papel has been added to all members.

all_promo.label: Promotion incentive
all_promo.text: For the new term incentive, {amount} papel has been loaded to all member balances.

all_loyalty.label: Loyalty thank-you
all_loyalty.text: Thank you for your contributions — {amount} papel has been gifted to all members.

remove_all_adjustment.label: General balance adjustment
remove_all_adjustment.text: A deduction of {amount} papel has been applied to all members as part of a general balance adjustment.

remove_all_fee.label: General transaction fee
remove_all_fee.text: A deduction of {amount} papel has been applied to all members as a general transaction fee.
